professionalSummary.title: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Experienced in teaching diverse learners—including GED candidates and university students—by breaking down complex topics into understandable steps and tailoring instruction to individual needs. Skilled in using data to monitor progress and continuously improve teaching strategies. Passionate about fostering critical thinking, problem-solving, and a genuine love for mathematics in every student.
